headline: Zydus Q2 FY27 Revenue Grows 29% Amid Margin Pressure
summary: Zydus reported 29% revenue growth for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, though the performance was tempered by margin pressure.
why: Pharmaceutical companies balance top-line revenue expansion with research, development, and manufacturing costs, making profit margins a critical metric for investors.

impacts.name: Zydus Lifesciences
impacts.why: Strong revenue growth is offset by margin pressure, presenting a mixed picture for profitability.
